rule: Append-only. Each entry is one kernel: the vendored kernels (vendorManifestSha256, from productionCommit), the GCP compute closure (computeClosureSha256, cloud-run/analytics-kernel-closure.mjs) and the orchestration method (methodVersion). Ids are assigned here, never by a database, so they are identical in every environment. Never edit or remove an entry: a changed closure, vendor manifest or method is a new entry with the next id. scripts/analytics-v2-kernel-registry.check.mjs pins every entry and refuses a closure no entry names.
